rationale: The registry already enrols every pneumonia admission with five years of possible follow-up, and linkage can supply outcomes and comparison groups. A registry-based cohort with two comparison groups, general population controls and patients admitted for other infections, brackets the effect (c2); frailty from admissions in the two years before the index admission handles the main confounding (c3), and splitting follow-up at one year separates the early excess from any late one (c1).
alternatives: Cohort against population controls only (refused: overstates the effect)
Self-controlled case series of cardiovascular events (kept as a sensitivity analysis for the first year)
Prospective follow-up of new pneumonia patients (refused: five years to answer a question the registry can answer now)
whyNotMoreComplex: Existing registry and linked data answer the question; new recruitment would add years without adding validity.

decision.statement: Conduct a registry-based cohort of 11,800 pneumonia survivors discharged in 2016 to 2021 with linked death and admission outcomes, against matched population controls and patients admitted for other infections, with frailty measured before admission and follow-up split at one year.
decision.question: How should the unit estimate long-term outcomes after community-acquired pneumonia?

criteria.text: Published cohorts show an early excess that shrinks later and with adjustment, so a local estimate with better confounding control is informative.
Two comparison groups bracket the effect.
The data access committee refuses linkage.

gates.requirement: Research ethics coverage for secondary use of registry data
gates.evidence: Standing approval REB-SP-2016-04 with a waiver of consent, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: Data access committee and statistics office approval of linkage and the comparison groups

decision.note: Rests on ledger claims c1 to c3 from the second, broader search; the linkage gate stays unknown until February at the earliest.

summary: Registry-based cohort recommended; the decision rests on three ledger claims and waits for the linkage decision.
